dependency_revisions.reason: Shared UTF-8 scalar decoding and Unicode White_Space classification.
The published embedded runtime and model now decode the chunked ProcessRequest shape used by Doctor's frozen Stdlib process contract.

responsibilities_moved: Trim the full token and both dot-separated components using the shared Unicode White_Space classifier
Recognize X.Y structure and Rust's optional leading plus sign for each numeric component
Parse ASCII decimal components with u32 overflow detection
Carry grammar and decimal state across fixed-size UTF-8-aligned input chunks
migration.production_host_code_retired: The Rust trim, split_once, and u32 parse chain was removed from FromStr. Rust now frames UTF-8 boundaries, transports bytes and native state, and converts the native coordinates to LanguageVersion.
migration.independent_reference: The previous Rust parser remains only under cfg(test), and the header scanner parity oracle calls it directly rather than the migrated FromStr implementation.
migration.compatibility: Differential cases include unbounded whitespace and zero padding beyond a chunk, optional signs, malformed forms, overflow, every Unicode White_Space scalar, nearby exclusions, and chunk-boundary Unicode whitespace.
migration.domain_boundary: Profile registry data stays host-loaded under DOC-P-007.

freeze.command: scripts/freeze-doctor-family.sh with explicit MNCS compiler, Language, Stdlib, and Commons roots
freeze.details: Compiled the Doctor native family, regenerated the typed host binding and frozen family backend, and executed the family and Stdlib SHA-256 corpora.

differential_parser.details: The independent old Rust parser matched the production native parser across syntax, whitespace, overflow, malformed values, long inputs, and UTF-8 chunk boundaries. Native provenance recorded parse_chunk16 or parse_chunk64 and finish_parse.

consumer_integration.details: The public migration target resolver parsed a Unicode-whitespace and signed X.Y target through LanguageVersion::FromStr and rejected overflow.

repository_test_matrix.reconciliation: The first locked full-suite invocation exposed two parity harness compile failures because the version module now imports Stdlib. The test helper was updated to load the same frozen Doctor family artifact used by production. The full 21-test parity target then passed, as did all remaining targets; the combined final target matrix above is complete.

resource_contract.runtime: Existing cached Doctor production policy session; no extra process or cache.
resource_contract.input_shapes: 16-byte and 64-byte native kernels, with host chunking only at valid UTF-8 boundaries.
resource_contract.follow_up: Importing the full text_utf8 module adds 65 callable exports and doubles the family backend. GitHub accepted the push with a 79.04 MB large-file warning. Extract a smaller shared UTF-8 scalar/whitespace kernel in Stdlib and re-freeze Doctor as the next migration.
